MARKETING_DESCRIPTION: The Grizzly Industrial Benchtop Oscillating Edge Belt and Spindle Sander is a versatile tool that combines edge belt and spindle sanding capabilities in one compact benchtop machine. It allows quick conversion between belt and spindle configurations using the included spindle nut wrench. The tilting table features preset detents at 0°, 15°, 22.5°, 30°, and 45° for precise angle sanding. This sander includes five sanding sleeves with matching table inserts in sizes 1/2", 3/4", 1", 1-1/2", and 2", making it a perfect addition to any workshop.
